candidates: In all mermaid diagram examples (demos, documentation, and test fixtures), use the frontmatter configuration block (a `---` YAML header) to set diagram config. The older directives syntax is considered obsolete in this project and should not be introduced in new code.

When propagating parent graph properties to subgraph configurations in `dagre-wrapper` (e.g., when calling `node.graph.setGraph` before a `recursiveRender` call), explicitly destructure and copy only the specific properties you intend to override (e.g., `ranksep`, `nodesep`). Avoid spreading the full parent graph config object, as that silently overwrites subgraph-specific layout values (such as `marginy`) and can cause subtle visual regressions.

A bugfix that changes the rendered output for users who had previously configured specific settings (even if correcting incorrect behavior) should be released as a MINOR semver bump, not a PATCH, because it constitutes a visible behavior change for existing users.

When adding a rendering fix or new rendering behavior to `demos/flowchart.html`, also add a corresponding `imgSnapshotTest` in `cypress/integration/rendering/flowchart-v2.spec.js` so that the behavior is covered by automated visual regression tests.
